title: Corner Detector
text: Find corners using FAST or Harris algorithm, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Padding method} sets Method for padding; {Method} sets the detection method FAST, {Source of minimum contrast value} sets the source for threshold that indicates corner for FAST algorithm, {MinContrast value} sets the threshold that indicates corner for FAST, {Source of threshold value} sets the source for threshold that indicates corner for Harris algorithm, {Threshold value} sets the threshold that indicates corner for Harris, {Line buffer size} sets the size of line buffer, {Rounding mode} sets the rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow action for internal fixed-point and {Output} sets the data type for corner output port Inherit same as first. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Method
params.values: Detection method FAST 5 of 8 (default) | FAST 7 of 12 | FAST 9 of 16 | Harris

params.values: Source for threshold that indicates corner for FAST algorithm Property (default) | Input port

params.values: Method for padding Symmetric (default) | Replicate | Reflection | None

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Overflow action for internal fixed-point calculations off (default) | on

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type for corner output port Inherit same as first input (default) | data type expression | Inherit via internal rule
